messages:
sasha-support: FYI customer ACME reports a 403 on embeddings even though their app token works for other endpoints. They say it started after they upgraded their seat plan. Repro steps & curl below.

sasha-support: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_app_ABC123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello world","model":"rwd-embedding-1"}'
```

sasha-support: Response body: ```
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Forbidden",
    "status": 403,
    "reason": "entitlement_denied",
    "hint": "plan_limit_exceeded",
    "request_id": "req-8a7f2b3c"
  }
}
```

alex-eng: Thanks — can you confirm the tenant_id and the request_id? Also paste any x- headers from the response (x-request-id/x-trace/x-entitlement).

sasha-support: tenant_id=ten-acme-42, request_id=req-8a7f2b3c, x-entitlement: plan=starter;seats=5;usage=6;check=denied

alex-eng: Looks like the entitlement service returned a plan check failure (usage 6 > seats 5). This should indeed be a 403, but it is being surfaced to the customer as an "invalid token" in some SDKs which is confusing.

opsbot: trace req-8a7f2b3c -> svc-proxy -> svc-entitlement.vpc -> svc-billing (t=120ms) | entitlement_result=DENIED (code=PLAN_USAGE_EXCEEDED)

june-billing: ACME just submitted a seat upgrade but our billing webhook queue shows a retry backlog for tenant ten-acme-42. The upgrade hasn't been applied to the entitlement cache yet.

marta-cs: Customer on call now, they're seeing 403s in Prod after the upgrade screen. Can we prioritize?

alex-eng: Short-term options: 1) reconcile entitlement cache for ten-acme-42 (force refresh), 2) temporarily allowlist tenant for embeddings route while billing processes. I'll scope a minimal fix.

sasha-support: I can open a cache refresh job. Which endpoint?

alex-eng: POST to /internal/entitlement/refresh with body {tenant: "ten-acme-42"} (requires ops token). Or we can add to runtime gate allowlist: PUT /internal/gates/embeddings/allowlist -> add ten-acme-42.

june-billing: I'll re-run the webhook delivery now. ETA ~3m. Also pushing a job to reconcile missed upgrades.

opsbot: webhook-delivery job job-443 started for tenant=ten-acme-42 (retries=4)

deploy-bot: config change applied by sasha-support: embeddings gate allowlist updated (+ten-acme-42)

sasha-support: Applied allowlist, asked customer to retry. They report embeddings requests now succeed. :tada:

marta-cs: Confirmed with customer, they can proceed. We'll keep monitoring until the billing reconcile finishes.

alex-eng: Follow-up action items: 1) add clearer error mapping so entitlement failures don't show as invalid credentials in SDKs; 2) add webhook retry alerting for billing queues; 3) investigate race where UI shows upgrade as complete before billing webhook persisted.

sasha-support: Noted. Closing loop with customer and will escalate the SDK error mapping ticket to triage. :white_check_mark:
